title: Breakfast-Inclusive Group Rates: Damages Rate for Group Room Blocks
content:
**Ruling.** The damages rate of a Group Room Blocks cancellation follows the breakfast built into the group rate and how the named rooms are occupied:

- when the block type's group rate includes breakfast and the organiser's confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block average **at least 1.5 adults per room**, the damages rate is the group rate less **24.00 USD**;
- when the group rate includes breakfast and they average **fewer** adults, it is the group rate less **12.00 USD**;
- when the group rate includes no breakfast, or no such reservation exists, it is the group rate.

**Records read.** The organiser's Room Reservations that name the block, are booked at the Group Block Rate and stand confirmed, with the adults on each; the average is the total adults on those reservations divided by the number of those reservations.

### Breakfast in the group rate, by block type

| Block type | Group rate includes breakfast |
|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | No |
| Wedding Room Block | No |
| Sports Team Room Block | Yes |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | Yes |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | No |
| Association Convention Room Block | No |

### Worked rates (hypothetical Sports Team Room Block at a group rate of 159.00 USD, 10 confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming it)

| Adults on those reservations | Average per room | Damages rate |
|---|---|---|
| 20 | 2.0 | 135.00 USD |
| 15 | 1.5 | 135.00 USD |
| 14 | 1.4 | 147.00 USD |

A Corporate Meeting Room Block at the same group rate keeps a damages rate of 159.00 USD whatever the occupancy, its group rate including no breakfast.
